search_keyword: turn of month effect stock returns strategy rules first last trading days
page_summary: TapeScript blog on the turn-of-the-month (Ultimo) effect, citing Ariel (1987) and McConnell & Xu (2008, Financial Analysts Journal): from 1926-2005 essentially all of the US stock markets average positive return occurred in a 4-trading-day window per month -- the last trading day of the month plus the first three trading days of the next month. Rest of month averaged near zero. Confirmed across 34 other countries. Driven by predictable month-end cash flows (paychecks, 401k contributions, fund rebalancing).
notes: Concrete, parameter-light calendar-anomaly hypothesis: long only during last trading day of month + first N trading days of next month, flat otherwise. Testable directly on SPY/QQQ (equity) and BTC/USDT/ETH/USDT (crypto, to see if a cash-flow-driven equity effect transfers to a market without payroll/401k cycles).

search_keyword: gap fade opening gap reversal strategy rules stocks backtest
page_summary: DayTradingToolkit guide on the gap fade strategy: overnight gaps driven by retail attention/sentiment tend to reverse (fade) intraday once daytime arbitrageurs trade against the overnight order-flow imbalance, per academic research cited: Berkman/Koch/Tuttle/Zhang (2012, original finding: positive overnight returns followed by intraday reversals), Aboody/Even-Tov/Lehavy/Trueman (2018, confirmed with expanded methodology), Akbas/Boehmer/Jiang/Koch (2022, tug-of-war framing between overnight noise traders and daytime arbitrageurs). The articles specific setup (minute-level pre-market volume screening, opening-range entry triggers, intraday stop/target scaling) requires intraday/tick data this repos loaders (daily OHLCV via yfinance/ccxt) cannot provide, but the core academic finding -- overnight gap direction predicts an OPPOSITE intraday (open-to-close) return -- is directly testable at daily granularity using existing open/close columns.
notes: Adapted the daily-granularity-testable core of the academic finding: after a gap DOWN (open meaningfully below prior close), go long from open to close (intraday only), betting on a fade/reversal back up -- long-only per SAFETY.md, so only testing the gap-down-fade side (would require shorting to fade gap-ups). Distinct from 2026-09-03-007 (overnight_drift, which holds close-to-open) -- this holds open-to-close (the opposite sub-daily window) and is conditioned on a gap-down trigger rather than unconditional participation.
